scripts.build: npm run build -w @motory/shared && npm run build -w @motory/api && npm run build -w @motory/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @motory/shared && npm run build -w @motory/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @motory/shared && npm run build -w @motory/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @motory/shared && npm run typecheck -w @motory/api && npm run typecheck -w @motory/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run local -w @motory/api
